name: End of Everything
storyline:
The world didn’t die quietly.
First came the panic. Then the rot. Then everything fell apart.

In End of Everything, you’re dropped into the ruins of a collapsed world where the infected roam freely, resources are scarce, and survival is never guaranteed. Cities are abandoned, the land is unforgiving, and whatever caused the outbreak left scars — and secrets — buried deep within the environment.

This is a first-person survival game focused on long-term endurance, scavenging, crafting, base building, and discovery. Zombies are everywhere — not in waves, not on a timer — but as a constant threat you must fight through, avoid, or out think while learning how the world truly fell.

Survive. Scavenge. Build. Explore. Adapt.
The world won’t explain itself — you have to earn the answers.
summary:
End of Everything is a first-person open-world survival game set in a collapsing post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by the infected. Players must scavenge for supplies, craft weapons and tools, build shelters, and manage survival needs while navigating a hostile and unforgiving environment.

The game focuses on grounded survival systems, atmospheric exploration, and emergent gameplay, with an emphasis on long-term progression rather than scripted experiences. Currently in Early Access, End of Everything is actively evolving, with ongoing updates aimed at expanding content, improving performance, and refining core systems.
